newsitem.title: USA: FCOJ futures end higher after technical bounce.
newsitem.headline: FCOJ futures end higher after technical bounce.

text.p: NYCE frozen concentrated orange juice futures settled higher on a technical bounce Tuesday following yesterday's selloff, traders and analysts said.
"I think the market was overdone on the downside and should not have fallen as much as it did," said Judy Ganes of Merrill Lynch.

She noted that last year there were 10,000 fewer speculative long positions in the market than there are now. "I just don't see the specs getting much shorter going into the winter months," Ganes added.
January orange juice settled 1.10 cents firmer at 98.45 cents per pound, traded 98.80 to 97.20 cents. Today's gains almost negated the 1.85 cent loss made on Monday.
Volume was estimated at 5,000 lots compared to Monday's official 4,174 lots.
